title: Completion contract: assertive-slot success announcement per WCAG 4.1.3 plus per-file remove and retry
description: On successful completion of the upload set, the surface renders an assertive-slot announcement in a wrapper carrying role=status or aria-live=assertive with the string "<N> files uploaded successfully", per WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages. Every completed file row carries a keyboard-reachable remove control (returns the row to the pre-upload state and issues a DELETE against the transport where the transport supports removal) and a retry control (visible only after a refusal or a transport error). The completion announcement fires exactly once per set; a retried refusal that then succeeds increments the completed count but does not re-announce.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.2, REQ 5.
